tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Why did you go to the bank?” (Add did.)
B hears the question and builds the answer with a purpose: to + verb, in order to + verb, or so that + a new clause. Change the blue verb if you need to.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: 'So that' + a new subject: 'so that she could water the plants'.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
